Hi Devon —

Thanks for the quick read. Quick answers inline: 

> they want the test profile (RPS, payload size, concurrency) called out

We ran with the following baseline during the recorded run: 250 RPS, payload 1–2 KB, 8 concurrent workers, 128-token average response length. KV-cache warm start enabled for prefixes used in the test. I’ll add a 1-slide appendix to the deck with these specifics and a short note on cache hit assumptions.

> a short note on the KV-cache assumptions — can your SEs add that to the deck?

Yep — will add a short bullets section: cache warm fraction (~60%), expected cold-start token penalty (~35ms), and mitigation knobs (prefetch + warm cache policy).

I also want to confirm expected SLA targets so we frame recommendations: is the target p50 < 40ms and p95 < 120ms for the primary inference path? If that’s right I’ll include a gap table mapping recommended config changes to measured delta.

Quick note: I’m on PTO Tue morning PT but available Wed morning PT — so Wed 25 Nov 08:30 PT / 16:30 CET works for me too.

—Monica
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
